name: Korean peninsula
value: 4 weapons tests in a week to 4 Nov
summary: North Korea ran four weapons tests in the week to 4 Nov; no nuclear test or overflight of Japan reported
state: South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff detected several missiles fired toward the East Sea from the Sondok area on 4 Nov, flying under 300 km (Yonhap via Korea Times). State media described an air-defence test and a cruise missile drill, North Korea's fourth weapons test in a week, as South Korea and the US held air drills. Searches on 8 Nov found no later launch, nuclear test or ICBM overflight of Japan.
for_you: People in South Korea and Japan follow national alert systems during launches. Short-range tests rarely affect daily life or air travel, but repeated tests during allied drills tend to raise tension on the peninsula.
rubric_hit: Watch: missile launches, with four tests in the week to 4 Nov. Alert line (nuclear test, ICBM overflight of Japan or military clash) not met.

sources.title: Korea Times (Yonhap) — N. Korea says test-fired new air defense missile system, long-range cruise missile

why: North Korea is a nuclear state with ICBMs; tension here involves the US, China, Japan and Russia simultaneously.
